 Knicks vs Cavaliers Game Notes | November 7, 2026
 November 7, 2026 11:00 AM EST November 7, 2026 7:30 PM ET | Rocket Arena (Cleveland, OH) | Game 9; Away Game 4
 TV: MSG Networks/NBA TV; Radio: SiriusXM
 This Day in Knicks History 
 November 7, 1946: The Knicks hit the radio waves for the first time, as Marty Glickman and Sarah Palfrey Cook broadcast the 68-63 win at St. Louis on WHN.
 November 7, 2003: Allan Houston pours in 39 points and Keith Van Horn adds 20 points in a pulsating, come-from-behind 114-111 win over Sacramento at the Garden. Knicks score 71 points in the second half to fuel the comeback.
 Learn more about Knicks history. 
 Last Game vs. CLE: 
 Cleveland (2/24/26) – The New York Knicks were defeated by the Cleveland Cavaliers, 109-94. Mitchell Robinson led New York with 11 points on 83.3-percent shooting, 16 rebounds, two blocks and one assist off the bench. Mikal Bridges scored 18 points, five rebounds, three steals, two assists and one block. Karl-Anthony Towns registered 14 points on 100.0-percent shooting, seven rebounds, two assists, two blocks and one steal. Donovan Mitchell led Cleveland with 23 points, five rebounds, four assists and three steals. Jarrett Allen collected 19 points on 87.5-percent shooting, 10 rebounds, two blocks, one assist and one steal. Dean Wade recorded 11 points, eight rebounds, three assists, three steals and two blocks.
 Connections: 
 Knicks head coach Mike Brown was the head coach of the Cleveland Cavaliers for five consecutive seasons (2005-2010) and returned as head coach for the 2013-2014 season… Cavaliers President of Basketball Operations Koby Altman is from Brooklyn, NY…Cavaliers associate head coach Johnnie Bryant was the Knicks associate head coach from 2020-2024. NY Knicks announcer Walt “Clyde” Frazier played three seasons with the Cleveland Cavaliers (1977-80)…Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell was born in Elmsford, NY… Cavaliers assistant coach Omar Cook was born in Brooklyn, New York and attended St. John’s University in Queens, New York…Knicks guard Miles McBride was born in Cincinnati, Ohio…Cavaliers Head coach Kenny Atkinson was born in Northport, New York and was also an assistant coach for the Knicks for four seasons (2008-2012)...Cavaliers assistant coach Jawad Williams was coached by Knicks head coach Mike Brown for two seasons (2008-2010)... Cavaliers head coach Kenny Atkinson and Knicks head coach Mike Brown were assistant coaches for the Golden State Warriors for one season (2021-2022)...Cavaliers center Thomas Bryant was teammates with Josh Hart on the Los Angeles Lakers for one season (2017-18)… Knicks guard Jordan Clarkson and Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell were teammates on the Utah Jazz for three seasons (2019-2022) …Clarkson also played on the Cavaliers (2018-19)...Knicks guard Landry Shamet and Cavaliers guard James Harden played on the Brooklyn Nets together for one season (2020-21)...Knicks center Andre Drummond played on the Cavaliers during the 2019-21 seasons…Cavaliers forward Nae’Qwan Tomlin was born in Brooklyn, NY and grew up in Harlem while attending Urban Assembly High School.
 Last Game: 
 The New York Knicks defeated the Chicago Bulls, 135-105. Jalen Brunson led New York with 33 points on 58.8-percent shooting, four assists and two rebounds. Karl-Anthony Towns registered 17 points on 100.0-percent shooting, 12 rebounds, one assist and one steal. OG Anunoby added 18 points, five rebounds, two assists and three steals. Jaylin Sellers led Chicago off the bench with 14 points on 50.0-percent shooting, three rebounds, one assist, one steal and one block. Tre Jones came off the bench and registered 14 points on 62.5-percent shooting, four assists and three rebounds. Matas Buzelis added 12 points, five rebounds, three assists and one steal.
 KNICKS GRAB BULLS BY THE HORNS: 
 Jalen Brunson registered 33 points on 58.8-percent shooting, four assists, two rebounds vs. Chicago (Nov 4). This marks his 103rd time scoring 30+ points as a Knick, which ranks third in franchise history. Brunson also recorded 22 points in the first quarter marking his 11th time scoring 20+ points in a quarter as a Knick, which ranks first in franchise history.
 Karl-Anthony Towns tallied 17 points, 12 rebounds, one assist and one steal vs. Chicago (Nov 4). This marks his 122nd game recording a double-double as a Knick, which ranks 12th all-time in franchise history. This also marks his 486th career double-double, tying Giannis Antetokounmpo and Anthony Davis for sixth place among active players. Towns also recorded his eighth consecutive double-double to start the season which ranks fourth in franchise history.
 Jordan Clarkson has now scored 8,699 points off the bench in his career, passing Thurl Bailey (8,695 bench points) for seventh all-time since the 1968- 69 season (when tracking started).
 OG Anunoby registered 18 points, five rebounds, two assists and three steals vs. Chicago (Nov 4). His three steals in the first half, marked the 44th time he has recorded at least three steals in a half and 16th time as a Knick, which ranks fourth in franchise history. He also made 11 free throws, which tied his career high.
 Miles McBride recorded his 41st career game with two or more steals off the bench, which passes Rod Strickland and Chris Childs for ninth most in franchise history.
 Mohamed Diawara tallied two blocks, which marks his second time in his career recording two or more blocks in a game.
 James Wiseman recorded three blocks, which marks the ninth time in his career recording three or more blocks in a game and his first as a Knick.
 The Knicks scored 40+ points in both the first and second quarter for the first time in franchise history. The Knicks scored 84 points in the first half, tying their franchise record for points in the first half (at Philadelphia, Nov 18, 1988). The Knicks recorded their 14th win by at least 30 points since the start of last season, which is the most in the NBA.
